turns.text: Definitely. Work has been pretty hectic lately with my role as an account coordinator at the logistics firm, so this peace and quiet is exactly what I needed.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can imagine! The logistics industry doesn't really slow down, so you've definitely earned this relaxing Saturday. What's the plan for the rest of the afternoon?

turns.text: Just going to finish my black coffee, eat my deli sandwich in a bit, and maybe practice a few chords on the guitar. Hope you have a good day too!
